item.description:
This is a complete copy of the 2025 SDE Exclusive Blu-Ray Audio Deluxe Edition of Frankie Goes To Hollywood's "Welcome To The Pleasuredome".

  • 2025 Mixes in 24/48 Dolby Atmos (7.1 True-HD Atmos), 24/48 5.1 Surround Sound, 24/48 2.0 Stereo

  • Bonus Tracks Instrumental Mixes in 24/48 Dolby Atmos (7.1 True-HD Atmos), 24/48 5.1 Surround Sound, 24/48 2.0
